summary: Comprehensive testing of Seller Onboarding Guide feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass. Frontend: wizard modal, onboarding card, guide page (9 steps), auto vs manual step toggle behaviour, progress bar updates, react-joyride tour, and Arabic RTL all verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: SellerOnboardingCard swallows all fetch errors silently via `.catch(() => {})`. If /api/seller/onboarding/progress ever fails (e.g. 401 or 500) the card just disappears without any visible feedback — consider surfacing a small error state so sellers know onboarding tracking is unavailable.
SellerDashboard.jsx is 2335 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into per-tab modules (ShopsTab, ProductsTab, AnalyticsTab, WalletTab, etc.) for maintainability.
server.py is 6424 lines and should be split into routers by domain (auth, shops, products, orders, onboarding, admin) to reduce merge conflicts and cognitive load.

The `bulk` onboarding step relies on `user.meta.bulk_import_used` set inside bulk_import_products, but that flag is never cleared — if a seller deletes all their bulk-imported products the step stays 'done', which is arguably fine but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Reset admin's onboarding_progress collection (db.onboarding_progress.delete_many({})) and un-checked manual steps to force the wizard to display for testing. Test data was cleaned up by the test suite via uncheck-step calls in the module-scoped autouse fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints verified: GET/POST /api/seller/onboarding/{progress,complete-step,uncheck-step,dismiss-wizard,complete-tour}. All 9 step ids validated (profile, shop, product, delivery, payout, orders, analytics, bulk, reviews). Frontend flows verified: (1) /seller shows SellerOnboardingCard with progress-bar/open-guide/start-tour testids; (2) SellerFirstLoginWizard modal with prev/next/finish/close testids fires dismiss-wizard on close; (3) /seller/guide renders 9 guide-step-<id> cards with -toggle and -cta; auto steps show 'automatic' toast, manual steps update percent and can be unchecked; (4) 'Show me around' button starts react-joyride tour with tooltip on the onboarding card; (5) Arabic locale sets html dir='rtl' and lang='ar' and translates guide/wizard/tour strings. First fetch may take ~1s so the card renders after the API responds — earlier screenshots without card were race conditions, not bugs.
